notes.title: Play the Demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35261531/8b9fe3c9d4e45957d3e3f1c48e91889bcc52897a.png[/img]

Shishi : Ballad of the Oracle is featured at Steam Next Fest this week! To celebrate, we updated our demo with improved levels, new enemies and more! The update will be available on June 16.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105170/

We will also be doing a livestream showcasing the new demo. Join us on Steam or [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shishistudios]Twitch[/url] on Wednesday, June 16 at 1PM EST (10AM PST) for live gameplay!

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/shishistudios]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/SAJ5kUx]Discord[/url] to be notified when we go live! Have a great festival!

-Shishi Studios

notes.title: Games From Quebec Sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35261531/7678d2a9761c13bcf2711e711148a81db03496cc.jpg[/img]

We're so happy to be part of the Games From Quebec Steam Sale this weekend! Discover all the great games we make in Quebec!

Shishi : Ballad of the Oracle may only be available as a demo right now, but it's a good way to learn more about its story! Don't forget to add it to your wishlist and join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/SAJ5kUx]Discord[/url] to follow the development!

We also encourage you to have a look at all the games, there is something for every taste!

Download the demo here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105170/

notes.title: MEGAMIGS Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35261531/cd52fefc1ad5696c8eb9b9b8d5ee2299c6a50e5e.png[/img]

It's time! We just released the demo of Shishi : Ballad of the Oracle on Steam! Everyone can now try it as part of MEGAMIGS 2020! It will be available until Sunday.

We'll also be streaming the demo during the event, so come say hi!

Download here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105170/

notes.title: Gamescom Trailer Reveal!
notes.notes:
Watch the premiere of the trailer of Shishi : Ballad of the Oracle!

Our studio will be showcasing our game at Gamescom! Along with almost 200 developers, we're part of the [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/]Indie Arena Booth[/url].

This year, the showfloor took the form of an [b]interactive browser-based game[/b] that is easily accessible to everyone! There are a lot of unique indie games from all around the world to discover, so you should definitely have a look!

Indie Arena Booth Online will be live [b]August 27, 10 PM CEST until August 30, 11:59 CEST[/b]. Pre-registration is also open from now if you want to [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com]create your profile[/url] before the event starts.

[previewyoutube=mFXWfpDZPlA;full][/previewyoutube]

The trailer will be released on our [url=https://youtube.com/watch?v=mFXWfpDZPlA]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://twitch.tv/shishistudios]Twitch[/url] channels on [b]Thursday, August 27th, 11AM EST[/b], so don't forget to set a reminder to be among the first to see it!

Have a great Gamescom!
